text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan

(Perisytiharan Orang Hidup sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan) 2014.

Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Orang yang dinamakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

Warisan Kebangsaan dalam bidang yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

(1) (2)

Menteri Pelancongan dan Kebudayaan

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF LIVING PERSON AS NATIONAL HERITAGE)

ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the National Heritage

Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of Living

Person as National Heritage) Order 2014.

Declaration of National Heritage

2. The persons named in column (1) of the Schedule are declared as

National Heritage in the field specified in column (2).

SCHEDULE

(1) (2)

Name Field

Siri Neng Buah Cultural Figure

Kumaresan Karthigesu Sitar Musical Art

Mek Jah binti Deris Mak Yong
